says: A repository's review rule wins the concern review.approval over the Team's own review rule, which is shadowed; a second Team source is switched off, so its required unit is disabled; the Team's terms unit is kept because the winning rule needs it. Neither the shadowed Team rule nor the disabled unit is held as a body in the preparation, and neither may hold the session's start: the preparation the owner writes states no gap naming either of them, while it keeps the needed terms unit. This is the rule C07/gap_names_no_losing_unit; its fixture's breaking records - a gap naming the shadowed Team rule, or naming the switched-off unit's missing body - are what the owner must never write.
